about: F.REL .w (value.js COHESION §0ew ESC-FREL-g-2; F-REL.md addendum (a) .w): THE ONE committed manifest of producer-held e2e failures. Each row is a test whose cure is glass-ui's to ship, relayed by its O-id. playwright.config.ts reads this file and nothing else for the set: the gating cells (chromium, mobile-chromium) exclude exactly these rows, the honest-red project runs exactly these rows, and e2e/honest-red-reporter.ts fails the run if a row passes (glass landed: adopt it and delete the row), matches no test, is skipped, or fails without its token. CI prints this file on every run. Every other e2e failure blocks. A row leaves only by adoption, and expires at its stated repin.
